role_assignments_dates.name: role_assignments_dates
role_assignments_dates.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from

users_has_login.name: users_has_login
users_has_login.value: login_phone IS NOT NULL OR login_email IS NOT NULL

attendance_events_location_status_check.name: attendance_events_location_status_check
attendance_events_location_status_check.value: location_status IS NULL OR location_status IN ('inside','outside','poor_accuracy','not_configured','not_taken')

work_days_minutes_check.name: work_days_minutes_check
work_days_minutes_check.value: worked_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1440 AND overtime_minutes >= 0 AND overtime_minutes <= worked_minutes

weekly_off_rules_dates.name: weekly_off_rules_dates
weekly_off_rules_dates.value: valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= valid_from

expense_claims_not_self_approved.name: expense_claims_not_self_approved
expense_claims_not_self_approved.value: approved_by IS NULL OR approved_by <> person_id

expense_claims_not_self_rejected.name: expense_claims_not_self_rejected
expense_claims_not_self_rejected.value: rejected_by IS NULL OR rejected_by <> person_id

expense_claims_approved_within_claim.name: expense_claims_approved_within_claim
expense_claims_approved_within_claim.value: approved_amount_paise IS NULL OR (approved_amount_paise > 0 AND approved_amount_paise <= amount_paise)

expense_claims_paid_has_details.name: expense_claims_paid_has_details
expense_claims_paid_has_details.value: status <> 'paid' OR (paid_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_ref IS NOT NULL)

expense_claims_rejected_has_reason.name: expense_claims_rejected_has_reason
expense_claims_rejected_has_reason.value: status <> 'rejected' OR rejection_reason IS NOT NULL

employments_exit_after_join.name: employments_exit_after_join
employments_exit_after_join.value: exit_on IS NULL OR exit_on >= joined_on

employments_exited_has_date_and_reason.name: employments_exited_has_date_and_reason
employments_exited_has_date_and_reason.value: status <> 'exited' OR (exit_on IS NOT NULL AND exit_reason IS NOT NULL)
